site.heroLede: Your neighbourhood gym, by the sea. Personal and semi-personal training in a small, warm room on Akti Themistokleous. We greet you at the door, we know your name, and we train together.
site.spaceBody: Brado is not a chain and not a crowd. It is a corner of Piraeus where movement, discipline and the people who show up have always mattered. You walk in, someone smiles, and the hour is yours — with a coach who sees you, not a number on a screen.
site.trainingLead: Three ways to train with us — always with a human plan, never a template off the shelf.
site.offer1Body: One coach, one athlete. A programme written around your goals and adjusted session by session.
site.offer2Body: A small group with the coach's eyes on everyone — together, but never lost in the crowd.
site.offer3Body: Food that supports the work you put in here, so progress shows up outside the gym too.
site.trainingNote: Every session runs 60 minutes and starts on the hour or at half past.
site.peopleTitle: Three little moments that feel like home
site.peopleLead: Not features — just how a good hour here tends to feel.
site.moment1Body: The small fix to your form, the extra rep you didn't think you had, the laugh between sets. Someone who knows how your week has been.
site.moment2Body: Enough energy to lift each other, enough quiet to hear your coach when it counts.
site.moment3Body: Step outside and the waterfront is waiting. Training here doesn't end at the last rep — it spills into the rest of your day.
site.boardNote: Start times in Athens time. Book your place by phone.
site.harbourBody: On Akti Themistokleous, a few steps from the water. Same faces, same welcome, every time you walk in.
site.visitLead: Drop by, call, or message us on Instagram. No forms, no fuss — we would love to show you the space.
site.footerLine: A small training centre on the Piraeus waterfront. Familiar faces, the sea a few steps away.
